description: Bring Your Own Bucket S3 relay. Connect your own S3-compatible storage (AWS S3, DigitalOcean Spaces, MinIO, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, …) and serve objects through the UnitySVC gateway, which returns presigned redirect URLs — clients download directly from your upstream bucket. This is a multi-channel service: the free `byok` channel relays one bucket you store once as customer secrets (`S3_RELAY_*`), while the metered `plus` channel lets you run many buckets under a single account — each enrollment binds its own bucket/endpoint/credentials and is reached at a unique `/e/<code>` address. See “How to use this service” for both channels.
name: s3-relay

payout_price.description: No platform commission — customer uses own storage
